# App-server fixtures (E4, and the M9 ChatGPT collector)

**DRAFT-documented-shape.** The shapes follow the Codex app-server protocol (R6) and the [ChatGPT account report contract](../../../docs/tech/data-and-sources.md#chatgpt-account-report). Every fixture value is invented.

Nothing here is a real email, account, token, plan or usage figure. `SENTINEL_*` strings stand where real text would be (the email, the notice text), so `test/experiments/sentinel.test.ts` can prove the script never prints or records them.

| File                | Shape comes from                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | Used for                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `fake-codex.ts`     | R6: `codex app-server` speaks JSON-RPC over stdio JSONL (`initialize`, then `initialized`; no `jsonrpc` header)                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | A stand-in for `codex`, started with `--bin codex=<this file>`. It reads `FAKE_CODEX_SCENARIO` (a path), answers each request from the scenario, sends a notification before every answer, and exits when its standard input closes |
| `signed-in.json`    | R6: `account/read` returns `{ account: { type, email, planType }, requiresOpenaiAuth }`; `account/usage/read` returns `summary` (`lifetimeTokens`, streak fields, `peakDailyTokens`) and `dailyUsageBuckets: [{ startDate, tokens }]`; `account/rateLimits/read` returns `usedPercent`, `windowDurationMins`, `resetsAt` per window | A ChatGPT sign-in with seven daily buckets (1 to 7 November 2026)                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `buckets-null.json` | R6: buckets may be `null` (TECH E4, P-34)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | Signed in, but no buckets                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `api-key.json`      | `docs/tech/data-and-sources.md` › Discovery (`unavailable`: API-key auth has no usage report)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | Signed in with an API key                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `usage-silent.json` | TECH › Failure modes (app-server hangs: 10 s per-call timeout)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | The usage call is never answered; the case sets `--call-timeout-ms` low                                                                                                                                                             |

Bucket tokens are 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600 and 700 for 1 to 7 November, so 3 to 5 November sums to 1,200.

## Added for the M9 ChatGPT collector (A32)

`scenario.ts` is the script interpreter. `fake-codex.ts` (a real child process) and the in-process scripted app-server in `test/collectors/chatgpt/scripted.ts` both read scenarios through it, so a scenario file means the same to both. Besides `silent` and `result` / `error`, an entry can be `exit` (the child ends without answering), `{ sequence: [...] }` (the n-th call of a method gets the n-th entry; the last repeats, which is how `thread/list` pages) and `{ result, then: [notification, ...] }` (notifications sent after the answer, such as `account/login/completed`). The four existing scenario files are unchanged, and `fake-codex.ts` answers them exactly as before.

| File                        | Shape comes from                                                                                                | Used for                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| --------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `chatgpt-with-threads.json` | `signed-in.json` plus R6's `thread/list` (`data[]` with `id`, `name`, `preview`; `nextCursor`)                  | A full read: three `thread/list` pages (live page 1 with a cursor, live page 2, archived), one thread with a null name, one with no session here, and a `SENTINEL_PREVIEW_*` preview on every thread |
| `signed-out.json`           | R6: `account/read` returns `account: null`                                                                      | Codex has no account: names are still read, no usage is                                                                                                                                              |
| `login-ok.json`             | R6: `account/login/start` returns `loginId` and `authUrl`; `account/login/completed` reports `success`          | A browser sign-in that finishes at once. The `authUrl` carries a `SENTINEL_STATE_*` marker                                                                                                           |
| `login-denied.json`         | as above, with `success: false` and an error sentence                                                           | A sign-in Codex refuses. The sentence is a `SENTINEL_NOTE_*`                                                                                                                                         |
| `auth-error.json`           | An invented JSON-RPC error whose sentence sounds like a refused sign-in (not confirmed against the real server) | Usage and rate-limit reads that fail with a "sign in again" error: the card asks to reconnect and the sentence is dropped                                                                            |
| `crash.json`                | TECH › Failure modes (app-server errors)                                                                        | The child ends when it is asked for usage                                                                                                                                                            |
| `buckets-messy.json`        | Invented malformed items                                                                                        | A bucket that repeats a date, one dated by an epoch, items that are not dates or whole numbers, and windows with a negative percentage, no length or an unusable id                                  |

Every value is invented. The `SENTINEL_*` strings stand where real text would be, and the collector tests prove none of them reaches a table, a log or an API response (the one exception is the sign-in address, which is the browser's to open).
